messages:
melissa: kicking off prod deploy for routing-v2 now. plan is staged FF ramp: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% over ~30m windows. deploy-bot will handle toggles. tagging @sre-oncall for watches and @carla for rollout notes. low-risk canary first, then broader if metrics look good.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle: feature_flag:new-routing cohort=0.5% start_ts=3765432130 expected_duration=30m. command: ```/ff toggle --flag new-routing --percent 0.5 --note "canary"``` will run at scheduled time.

ian: quick Q — are we pinning model version for the canary traffic? last time an unpinned rollout caused model drift.

carla: yes, pinning to model: routing-v2@2026-03-18-rc3 for the canary. fallback path is routing-v1@stable. I'll add that to the release notes.

melissa: ack. LOE on rollback: if any of these thresholds hit we soft-disable and then full rollback: 1) p99 latency > baseline +200ms sustained 3 consecutive samples (5m), 2) 5xx rate >0.5% for 5m, 3) model-quality regression > 1% on the sanity prompt set (eval job id: eval-8892). If triggered we disable FF cohort and pin traffic back to routing-v1.

ben: added the rollback criteria to the release notes draft and linked the canary dashboard: https://dashboard.redwood/boards/routing-v2-canary

sre-oncall: I'll be watching those dashboards and have slack alerts wired. runbook if alerted: https://internal/runbooks/ff-rollback. If we need immediate mitigation I can trigger the emergency soft-disable (`/ff toggle --flag new-routing --percent 0 --force`) and coordinate a rollback deploy.

melissa: starting canary toggle now (manual trigger to kick off early). deploying config -> `/deploy release routing-v2 --flags new-routing=cohort:0.5 --pin model=routing-v2@2026-03-18-rc3`

deploy-bot: toggle successful: feature_flag:new-routing cohort=0.5% active at 3765432132 by melissa. logs: deployment-id=deploy-3765 route=prod/routing

ian: thanks. initial traffic looks clean. p50/p90 stable, no increase in errors.

carla: noted slight bump in tail latency +30ms, within tolerance. holding for next window.

melissa: moving to 2% in 20m unless we see regressions. will post before each step. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle: feature_flag:new-routing cohort=2% start_ts=3765432250 expected_duration=30m.

sre-oncall: reminder: on-call will escalate if thresholds breached. ping me here if you want me to run the soft-disable early.

ben: final: I'll push the brief release note after 50% confirmation with rollback steps and contact list.

melissa: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for toggles and rollback decisions. we won't open a separate thread unless we need an incident channel.
